---
title: "National Inpatient Sample Study"
params:
  data_path: null
  years: [2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022]
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
# Expensive chunks are cached. To force a full re-run, delete the
# analysis_cache folder next to this file.
library(easyNIS)
library(purrr)
library(srvyr)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust", survey.adjust.domain.lonely = TRUE)
gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal("jama")

is_example <- is.null(params$data_path)
input_path <- if (is_example) {
  nis_example(years = params$years)
} else {
  params$data_path
}

nis_data <- nis_open(input_path, years = params$years)
```

## Study definitions

```{r}
#| label: definitions
# ---- Study definitions: edit this block for each study ----
codes <- list(
  principal_dx = c("I50"),
  exposure = c("Z515")
)

cohort <- rlang::expr(principal_dx & AGE >= 18)
exposure <- "exposed"
# The default adjusts for year only when more than one year is selected.
covariates <- c(
  "AGE", "FEMALE",
  if (length(params$years) > 1L) "factor(YEAR)"
)
annualize <- FALSE
outcomes <- dplyr::tibble(
  outcome = c("DIED", "LOS", "cost_adj"),
  family = c("quasibinomial", "gaussian", "gaussian"),
  exponentiate = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
)

nis_data <- nis_data |>
  nis_flag_dx(principal_dx = codes$principal_dx, position = "principal") |>
  nis_flag_dx(exposed = codes$exposure, position = "any")

# The example data is small and content-hashed because its temporary directory
# changes on every render. User-provided files use path, size, and modification
# time to avoid rescanning large Parquet inputs. Parsed setup/definitions code,
# package functions, dependency versions, and survey options complete the key;
# prose and comments do not invalidate the design. Changes made by sourced
# scripts or mutable environment state are not detected; include their explicit
# values in a cache key or rerun affected chunks.
data_files <- list.files(input_path, pattern = "[.]parquet$",
  recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
design_key <- easyNIS:::nis_study_cache_key(
  input_path = input_path,
  is_example = is_example,
  data_files = data_files,
  years = params$years,
  codes = codes,
  cohort = rlang::expr_text(cohort),
  annualize = annualize,
  source_chunks = list(
    setup = knitr::knit_code$get("setup"),
    definitions = knitr::knit_code$get("definitions")
  ),
  survey_options = list(
    lonely_psu = getOption("survey.lonely.psu"),
    adjust_domain_lonely = getOption("survey.adjust.domain.lonely")
  )
)
report_key <- easyNIS:::nis_study_report_cache_key(
  design_key = design_key,
  exposure = exposure,
  covariates = covariates,
  outcomes = outcomes,
  output_format = knitr::is_html_output()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: design
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr design_key
study_design <- rlang::inject(
  nis_design(
    nis_data,
    !!cohort,
    keep = c(
      AGE, FEMALE, DIED, LOS, TOTCHG, CCR_NIS,
      principal_dx, exposed
    ),
    annualize = annualize,
    dollars = max(params$years)
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: design-summary
cohort_n <- nrow(study_design$variables)
has_cohort <- cohort_n > 0L
exposure_values <- if (has_cohort && exposure %in% names(study_design$variables)) {
  study_design$variables[[exposure]]
} else {
  logical()
}
exposure_levels <- unique(exposure_values[!is.na(exposure_values)])
has_exposure_comparison <- length(exposure_levels) >= 2L
n_hospitals <- dplyr::n_distinct(
  study_design$variables$YEAR,
  study_design$variables$HOSP_NIS
)
weight_description <- if (annualize) {
  "DISCWT divided by the number of study years"
} else {
  "DISCWT"
}
```

## Methods

This study includes NIS years `r paste(params$years, collapse = ", ")`. The
analysis cohort uses principal diagnosis prefix
`r paste(codes$principal_dx, collapse = ", ")` and is defined by
`r rlang::expr_text(cohort)`. It contains `r format(cohort_n, big.mark = ",")`
discharges. The design uses year-specific HOSP_NIS clusters and NIS_STRATUM
strata, with `r weight_description` weights, and includes `r n_hospitals`
hospitals with cohort discharges. Cost and charges are adjusted to
`r max(params$years)` USD using CPI-U. The report uses easyNIS
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("easyNIS"))`, R `r getRversion()`, survey
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("survey"))`, srvyr
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("srvyr"))`, dplyr
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("dplyr"))`, and gtsummary
`r as.character(utils::packageVersion("gtsummary"))`.

`r if (!has_cohort) "Cohort-dependent summaries and models are unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design." else if (!has_exposure_comparison) paste0("The exposure comparison is unavailable because ", exposure, " has fewer than two observed levels in the cohort.") else "The cohort has at least two observed exposure levels; comparative summaries and models will be evaluated."`

The placeholder-row design and cost adjustment are experimental pending
scientific approval.

**Cells based on ≤10 unweighted discharges are masked (with the overall cell in the same row); review tables for other derivable cells before sharing, per the HCUP Data Use Agreement.**

## Cohort flow

The first three rows are lazy aggregates over the opened data. The final row
comes from the survey design, which also drops discharges with a missing or
non-positive `DISCWT`, `NIS_STRATUM`, or `HOSP_NIS`.

```{r}
#| label: flow
flow_summary <- function(data, step) {
  data |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      weighted_discharges = sum(DISCWT, na.rm = TRUE) # Data-masked field in the lazy query. # nolint
    ) |>
    dplyr::collect() |>
    dplyr::mutate(step = step)
}

flow_all <- flow_summary(nis_data, "All discharges")
flow_principal_dx <- flow_summary(
  dplyr::filter(nis_data, principal_dx), "Principal diagnosis prefix"
)
flow_cohort <- flow_summary(
  rlang::inject(dplyr::filter(nis_data, !!cohort)), "Cohort definition"
)
flow_analysis <- dplyr::tibble(
  n = cohort_n,
  weighted_discharges = sum(study_design$variables$DISCWT),
  step = "Analysis cohort (valid survey design)"
)

flow_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  flow_all, flow_principal_dx, flow_cohort, flow_analysis
)
stopifnot(flow_analysis$n[[1L]] <= flow_cohort$n[[1L]])
flow_display <- flow_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    discharges = dplyr::if_else(
      n >= 1 & n <= 10, "≤10", format(n, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
    ),
    weighted_discharges = dplyr::if_else(
      n >= 1 & n <= 10,
      "≤10",
      formatC(weighted_discharges, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(step, discharges, weighted_discharges)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  gt::gt(flow_display)
} else {
  flextable::flextable(flow_display)
}
```

## Table 1

```{r}
#| label: table-one
#| cache: true
#| dependson: design
#| cache.extra: !expr report_key
if (!has_cohort) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Table 1 is unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design."
  )
} else {
  table_one <- if (has_exposure_comparison) {
    gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
      study_design,
      by = exposed,
      include = c(AGE, FEMALE, DIED, LOS, cost_adj)
    ) |>
      gtsummary::add_p() |>
      gtsummary::add_overall() |>
      nis_suppress(threshold = 10)
  } else {
    gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
      study_design,
      include = c(AGE, FEMALE, DIED, LOS, cost_adj)
    ) |>
      nis_suppress(threshold = 10)
  }

  if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    gtsummary::as_gt(table_one)
  } else {
    gtsummary::as_flex_table(table_one)
  }
}
```

## Trends by year

The trend chart omits years with 10 or fewer cohort discharges. The table
masks each displayed estimate and count for those years.

```{r}
#| label: trends
#| cache: true
#| dependson: design
#| cache.extra: !expr report_key
if (!has_cohort) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Trends are unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design."
  )
} else {
trend <- study_design |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    .died = as.numeric(DIED == "Yes"),
    .one = 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mortality = srvyr::survey_mean(.died, vartype = "ci", na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_los = srvyr::survey_mean(LOS, vartype = "ci", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unweighted = dplyr::n(),
    weighted_n = srvyr::survey_total(.one, vartype = NULL),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

trend_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  trend |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR, measure = "In-hospital mortality",
      estimate = mortality, lower = mortality_low, upper = mortality_upp,
      n_unweighted
    ),
  trend |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR, measure = "Mean length of stay",
      estimate = mean_los, lower = mean_los_low, upper = mean_los_upp,
      n_unweighted
    )
) |>
  dplyr::filter(n_unweighted > 10)

ggplot2::ggplot(
  trend_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = YEAR, y = estimate, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, group = 1)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(alpha = 0.2) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = params$years) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Discharge year", y = "Survey estimate") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()

trend_display <- trend |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    YEAR = as.character(YEAR),
    discharges = dplyr::if_else(
      n_unweighted <= 10, "≤10",
      format(n_unweighted, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
    ),
    weighted_N = dplyr::if_else(
      n_unweighted <= 10, "≤10",
      formatC(weighted_n, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
    ),
    mortality = dplyr::if_else(
      n_unweighted <= 10, "≤10",
      paste0(formatC(100 * mortality, format = "f", digits = 1), "%")
    ),
    mean_LOS = dplyr::if_else(
      n_unweighted <= 10, "≤10",
      formatC(mean_los, format = "f", digits = 2)
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    `Discharge year` = YEAR, discharges, weighted_N, mortality, mean_LOS
  )

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  gt::gt(trend_display)
} else {
  flextable::flextable(trend_display)
}
}
```

## Multivariable models

Models use the exposure and covariates declared above. A model is shown only
when the observed data and fitted estimates are finite and usable. A valid
model with a design warning remains visible, with that warning shown below.
Unavailable models include the reason; the declared model specification is
not changed to make a model fit.

```{r}
#| label: models
#| cache: true
#| dependson: design
#| cache.extra: !expr report_key
model_results <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(outcomes)), function(i) {
  current <- outcomes[i, ]
  model_family <- switch(
    current$family[[1L]],
    quasibinomial = stats::quasibinomial(),
    gaussian = stats::gaussian()
  )
  formula <- stats::reformulate(
    c(exposure, covariates),
    response = current$outcome[[1L]]
  )
  easyNIS:::nis_study_fit_model(
    formula,
    design = study_design,
    family = model_family,
    outcome = current$outcome[[1L]],
    exposure = exposure
  )
})

valid_models <- which(vapply(model_results, function(result) {
  !is.null(result$model)
}, logical(1)))
model_tables <- purrr::map(valid_models, function(i) {
  gtsummary::tbl_regression(
    model_results[[i]]$model,
    exponentiate = outcomes$exponentiate[[i]]
  )
})

names(model_tables) <- as.character(valid_models)
family_rows <- split(valid_models, outcomes$family[valid_models])
family_tables <- purrr::map(family_rows, function(rows) {
  gtsummary::tbl_merge(
    tbls = model_tables[as.character(rows)],
    tab_spanner = paste0("**", outcomes$outcome[rows], "**")
  )
})

model_notes <- purrr::map_chr(seq_along(model_results), function(i) {
  result <- model_results[[i]]
  outcome <- outcomes$outcome[[i]]
  if (!is.null(result$status)) {
    return(paste0("**", outcome, " unavailable:** ", result$status))
  }
  if (length(result$warnings) > 0L) {
    return(paste0(
      "**", outcome, " model warning:** ",
      paste(unique(result$warnings), collapse = "; ")
    ))
  }
  ""
})
```

```{r}
#| label: model-tables
rendered_tables <- purrr::map_chr(family_tables, function(family_table) {
  table <- if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    gtsummary::as_gt(family_table)
  } else {
    gtsummary::as_flex_table(family_table)
  }
  rendered <- knitr::knit_print(table)
  metadata <- attr(rendered, "knit_meta", exact = TRUE)
  if (length(metadata) > 0L) {
    knitr::knit_meta_add(metadata)
  }
  as.character(rendered)
})
model_output <- c(model_notes[nzchar(model_notes)], rendered_tables)
if (length(model_output) == 0L) {
  knitr::asis_output("No model tables or model status messages were produced.")
} else {
  knitr::asis_output(paste(model_output, collapse = "\n\n"))
}
```
